name: C.E. Info Systems Ltd
title: C.E. Info Systems Ltd - 543425 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 rebound (revenue +54.8% QoQ, EBITDA margin 44.6%) but FY26 revenue only INR474 crores vs INR463 crores; management still targets INR1,000 crores by FY28 with a INR1,750 crores order book, while receivables rose to INR176 crores from INR133 crores.

triggers.label: Order conversion 17-18% of open book
triggers.quote: around 17%, 18%, I guess, 18% got converted into revenue

triggers.label: Receivables INR133 crores → INR176 crores
triggers.quote: The AR base that trade receivables, it was INR133 crores in last year, that is March '25, that has gone to INR176 crores in March '26?

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +54.8% QoQ rebound
triggers.quote: revenue growing by 54.8%, EBITDA increasing by 141% and PAT also growing by 171%

triggers.label: FY28 INR1,000 crores target kept, timing open
triggers.quote: the question is only could be of timing

guidance.quote: there is no reason not to believe that we cannot grow at 25% in the FY27
we are hoping to increase that 16% in this year

guidance.value: INR1,000 crores by FY28, timing may slip
guidance.quote: So our road map continues with INR1,000 crores.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Q4 revenue growth (Q3 call: similar or better than last year Q4)
prior_guidance_check.quote: If more revenue could have been converted in Q4, it would have been 75%. That's the gap.

red_flags.label: Receivables up 32% on flat revenue
red_flags.quote: The AR base that trade receivables, it was INR133 crores in last year, that is March '25, that has gone to INR176 crores in March '26?

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue miss vs own expectation; pushouts
red_flags.quote: If more revenue could have been converted in Q4, it would have been 75%. That's the gap.

red_flags.label: Government deferrals and re-tender
red_flags.quote: a lot of them got delayed or deferred for the next year

red_flags.label: Inventory build in IoT hardware amid rising memory prices
red_flags.quote: our inventory levels have grown. Yes, inventory levels have grown to stock up to support the increased demand

evasions.quote: Hard to say. I mean new orders that could have been won and then could have been executed in part
Hard to explain because it depends on different contracts.
I don't think that's the reason I wish that's not -- the reason for margin expansion is simply operating leverage
